files.summary: SiteDocument is a simple data class used in the HSPnet system for linking documents to specific Sites via their IDs.
files.purpose: To represent and access documents that are associated with a Site, likely for recordkeeping or document management related to Sites.
system_behavior: Encapsulates SiteDocument identity and its association to a Site.
content_gaps: No business rules, workflows or actor interactions are defined in the available content.

files.summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin provides a UI for staff with admin rights, showing recent login, filtering by Site/Discipline, and listing submitted employment applications.
files.purpose: To welcome staff admins, provide information about their last login, and help them view/filter employment application submissions by site, discipline, and date.

workflows.name: View Filtered Employment Applications
steps: Staff Admin logs in and is welcomed, last login displayed.
Select Site and Discipline from dropdowns.
Choose start and end dates (validated by required field and format).
Click Refresh to update applications grid.

business_rules: Start and End dates are required and must be valid date format.
Start date must not be after End date.
conditions: If SiteID is in query string, select that site; otherwise, default.
system_behavior: Displays error and warning messages in panels.
content_gaps: No details on backend methods for employment application search.
No business logic for user/role permissions beyond UI controls.

files.summary: Represents service codes with category, name, notes, and alternate-language support; includes methods to retrieve and localize lists by Course or Timetable.
files.purpose: To organize and provide service codes used in application features (e.g., as options for courses or timetables), supporting localization.

workflows.name: List Service Codes
steps: Query ServiceCodeListAll to get all available service codes.
Apply localization for alternate languages as needed.
Return the list to the caller.

workflows.name: List Service Codes by Course or Timetable

business_rules: If user session is in alternate language mode, use NameAlt/NotesAlt.
conditions: CourseID or TimetableID must be provided to list codes by those filters.
system_behavior: Queries database for codes and applies localization.
content_gaps: No details on UI presentation or mapping to business processes.

files.summary: Tracks changes to site profiles, capturing details about agency/user actions, fields changed, and audit metadata.
files.purpose: To provide an audit history for actions performed on Site profiles, including which fields were changed, who did it, and when.

workflows.name: Search Site Profile History
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch, which queries the database for actions associated with the Site.

business_rules: If alt language mode is set, display alternate field names.
If change initiated by HSPnet Support Team, show extra note in history.
calculations: ActionDateFormatted provides a short-form display of ActionDate.
AgencyUserFormatted and AgencyUserDetailsFormatted constructed to summarize actor details.
conditions: If ByUserSysAdmin is false and ByUserID does not match ByOriginalUserID, show HSPnet Support Team context.
system_behavior: Populates user/audit fields, shows who changed what and when.
content_gaps: Does not specify how field changes are rendered in the UI or how rollback is handled.
